in_sanskrit.name: शर्व
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Sharv is derived from the Sanskrit word शर्व (śarva), which means 'sacred' or 'auspicious'. It is also the name of a Hindu god associated with the Sun and the god of the army and prosperity. The name carries a deep spiritual significance and is often used for boys in Hindu communities.

in_hindi.name: शर्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Sharv in Hindi is शर्व (śarva), which has the same meaning as in Sanskrit. It is a popular name in Hindu communities and is often given to boys as it carries a deep spiritual significance and is associated with the Sun, the god of the army, and prosperity.

in_tamil.name: சர்வ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Sharv in Tamil is சர்வ (carl), which is derived from the Tamil word சர்வம் (śarvam), which has the same meaning as in Sanskrit. The name is often used for boys in Tamil communities and carries a deep spiritual significance.

in_telugu.name: శర్వ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Sharv in Telugu is శర్వ (śarvu), which is derived from the Telugu word శర్వపు (śarvapu). It has the same meaning as in Sanskrit and is often used for boys in Telugu communities.

in_marathi.name: Sharv
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharv हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rules or governs, a lord or ruler. In Hindu mythology, Sharv is an alternate name for Shiva, the god of destruction and transformation.
